notes.title: Try our demo at Tokyo Game Show!
notes.content: [p]We're excited to announce that [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3256150/Moomintroll_Winters_Warmth/"][u][i][b]Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth[/b][/i][/u][/url][i][b], [/b][/i]the[i][b] [/b][/i]highly anticipated follow up to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808680/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley/"]Snufkin[/url],[i][b] [/b][/i]will be playable for the first time ever with a public demo at Tokyo Game Show, taking place from September 25 - September 28, 2025. Fans can play a slice of the cozy, story-rich adventure at its booth in [b]Hall 5: 05-N08[/b] at the large Moominhouse. Can’t miss it! [/p][p][/p][p]And for those looking to experience the beloved [i]Snufkin[/i] universe for the first time,  [i]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley[/i] will be discounted on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808680/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley/"]Steam for 40% off[/url] for a limited time during Tokyo Game Show. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651934/60dd32d9e7731bc905a97cbfc331841911535165.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: First look at Moomintroll gameplay at The MIX 🥶
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651934/b1fd917ad3e76caffc9b4600addb90ab239bff2e.png"][/img][/p][p]We know that we've been stingy about revealing much from Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth yet, but that's about to change! [/p][p][/p][p]Tomorrow, [b]August 29 at 09:00 AM PST / 6PM CEST[/b] we will be part of The MIX showcase with a small preview from our upcoming Moomin game and sequel to Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley. [/p][p][/p][p]You can watch the showcase live on Youtube: 
 [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/c/MediaIndieExchange/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Or on Twitch:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/mediaindieexchange"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Hope to see you there![/p]

notes.title: Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth is part of the Wholesome Games Celebration 💚❄️
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]We are super excited to be part of this year’s Wholesome Games Celebration! 
[/p][p]The celebration on Steam invites players from around the world to experience a carefully curated selection of games that inspire hope, joy, and introspection. Running from August 7-14, the event will feature an exciting lineup of world premiere game announcements, new releases, discounts, and new demos.
[/p][p]We’re also celebrating by running a first ever -40% discount on [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808680/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley/"]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley[/url][/u] during the event. A great opportunity to check out the game, or to tell a friend about it! 
[/p][p]We strongly encourage you to visit [u][url="https://wholesomegames.com/"]Wholesome Games[/url][/u] to see the amazing lineup of games, and make sure to wishlist or buy the ones you like.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651934/c119eec67014899c2decb86618a091ef3845898e.gif"][/img][/p]
